name: ICD-11 WHO Version
description: WHO International Classification of Diseases, 11th Revision (MMS), modeled as a navigable classification hierarchy in OCL.

properties.description: OCL concept class that distinguishes the synthetic root, chapters, blocks, and diagnosis categories.
ICD-11 chapter the entity belongs to, verbatim from the Simple Tabulation (for example 01 or X). A string, because the extension chapter is not numeric.
Depth of the entity within its class kind, as defined by the Simple Tabulation readme: a category with depth 2 has a category parent whose own parent is not a category.
True when the entity is a residual category (other specified or unspecified), verbatim from the Simple Tabulation.
True when the entity has no children in the tabulation, verbatim from the Simple Tabulation.
WHO Simple Tabulation block identifier associated with the entity, when supplied.
WHO ICD-11 browser URL pinned to the imported release and language.
WHO ICD-11 Foundation entity URI supplied by the Simple Tabulation.
WHO ICD-11 MMS linearization URI supplied by the Simple Tabulation.

filters.description: Focuses the concept list on diagnosis categories rather than the synthetic root, chapters, and blocks.
Focuses the concept list on leaf entities.
